malformed_input.reason: Connected tests reject blank names, zero, negative, and over-three-decimal quantities with inline errors and unchanged Room row counts.

prompt_injection.reason: T4 has no prompt, model, remote content, or instruction-processing boundary.

cancel_resume.reason: T4 has no cancellable network or long-running user operation.

stale_state.reason: Equipment and pantry edits survive Activity recreation; exact debug seed data survives force-stop/start through DataStore and Room.

dirty_worktree.reason: Concurrent T3 backend, orchestration, and evidence changes were never staged or edited by T4.

hung_or_long_commands.reason: All Gradle, ADB, aapt, and secret-scan commands were bounded and completed; no command was abandoned.

flaky_tests.reason: A DataStore recreation race was exposed, fixed by awaiting the persisted observable and avoiding a false empty initial render, then the full focused class passed twice consecutively.

misleading_success_output.reason: Pass claims use parsed JVM and connected XML, direct Room row counts, aapt release XML, force-stop/start UI readback, and opened screenshots.

repeated_interruptions.reason: Visual reviewers examining superseded captures were interrupted; after the final source and capture refresh, two new independent reviewers both returned PASS with high confidence.
